repo_map_summary.description: Generate a summary of the repository map within a token budget.

budget_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens allowed for the summary output.

focus_files.description: Optional list of file paths to prioritize in the summary.

get_symbol_hierarchy.description: Return the inheritance/interface hierarchy for a given symbol.

symbol_name.description: Fully qualified name of the symbol (e.g., module.Class).

direction.description: Traversal direction: ancestors, descendants, or both.

max_depth.description: Maximum depth to explore in the hierarchy.

get_schema_registry.description: Retrieve the full data‑contract/schema registry produced by the schema facet.

resolve_imports.description: Resolve import relationships between two files, returning import paths and any circular dependencies.

source_file.description: Path to the file that performs the import.

target_file.description: Path to the file being imported.
